versions.subject: Filter dropbax
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'firewall'
        - 'delete'
filter_dropbox:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\Dropbox.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'name=Dropbox'
condition: selection and not filter_dropbox
